parameters.name: CertNo
parameters.description: The ID card number.

parameters.name: CertifyId
parameters.description: The certification ID.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The current page number.

parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description: The query end time. The format is a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: HasDeviceRisk
parameters.description: Specifies whether there is a device risk. Setting this parameter to true indicates that root = 1, simulator = 1, or virtual_video = 1.

parameters.name: Model
parameters.description: The liveness detection model.

parameters.name: OuterOrderNo
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the customer request.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: Passed
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the authentication passed:
- **T**: Passed.
- **F**: Failed.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description: The product code.

parameters.name: RiskBizScenario
parameters.description:
The business scenario risk:
- **0**: No risk.
- **1**: Risk detected.

parameters.name: RiskDevice
parameters.description:
The device risk:
- **0**: No risk.
- **1**: Risk detected.

parameters.name: RiskDeviceToken
parameters.description:
The DeviceToken risk:
- **0**: No risk.
- **1**: Risk detected.

parameters.name: RiskGeneric
parameters.description:
The generic risk:
- **0**: No risk.
- **1**: Risk detected.

parameters.name: RiskModelMining
parameters.description:
The large model mining risk:
- **0**: No risk.
- **1**: Risk detected.

parameters.name: Root
parameters.description: Specifies whether the device is rooted. Set to 1 if selected; otherwise, do not pass this parameter. This parameter corresponds to the identity tag risk type.

parameters.name: SceneId
parameters.description: The scene ID.

parameters.name: Simulator
parameters.description: Specifies whether the device is a simulator. Set to 1 if selected; otherwise, do not pass this parameter. This parameter corresponds to the device tag risk type.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: The query start time.

parameters.name: SubCode
parameters.description: The result code. For details, see [SubCode Description](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/id-verification/financial-grade-id-verification/error-code-person-verify?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6015566ebArcFw#d88910e172fgg).

parameters.name: SubCodes
parameters.description: Comma-separated result codes. For details, see [SubCode Description](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/id-verification/financial-grade-id-verification/error-code-person-verify?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6015566ebArcFw#d88910e172fgg).

parameters.name: VirtualVideo
parameters.description: Specifies whether virtual video is used. Set to 1 if selected; otherwise, do not pass this parameter. This parameter corresponds to the behavior tag risk type.
